newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Agrobank picks group for 5.5bln drachma plan.
newsitem.headline: Greek Agrobank picks group for 5.5bln drachma plan.

text.p: Greece's state Agricultural Bank approved a bid by the Intrasoft-Monitor-Ernst and Young-Planet consortium for a 5.5 billion drachma high-tech project to overhaul and automate its bank network, it said.
The consortium had been ranked first by the Agricultural Bank's evaluating committee and its advisor Price Waterhouse, it added.
The project includes research, planning, designing and implementation in the fields of market strategy, restructuring, human resources and informatics, it said.

The project will give Agricultural Bank a competitive adge in Greece and abroad over the next 20 years, its chairman Christos Papathanassiou said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
